original_value: Ultrasound (US) image segmentation plays a very important role in diagnostic imaging. In order to extract special tissues from images, this study proposes a new method for segmentation of US images. The proposed method uses multilevel threshold segmentation which is based on Otsu and differential search algorithm. Testing in simulation US images shows that the proposed algorithm has a better result of segmentation than the three existing methods, including region growing, the active contour model and k‐means technique. The proposed method gets the highest Fm values and the smallest area errors in experiments. Vivo US images are also tested by the proposed method and it achieves a good segmentation result.

result.paraphrase: Ultrasound (US) image segmentation is crucial in diagnostic imaging. To isolate specific tissues from images, this study presents a new US image segmentation approach. The proposed technique applies multilevel threshold segmentation based on Otsu and a differential search algorithm. Simulations on US images indicate that the algorithm outperforms three existing methods—region growing, the active contour model, and the k-means technique. In experiments, it achieves the highest Fm values and the lowest area errors. The method is also tested on vivo US images, where it delivers good segmentation results.
